title: Wick Liq Bar Juice Boulevard 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liq Bar Juice Boulevard brings the legendary taste of Wick Liquor’s most iconic blend to a punchy new format. It delivers a vibrant Mardi Gras fruit punch on the inhale, enriched by the sweet and slightly tart notes of Malibu Loganberry pulp on the exhale. This complex fruit fusion is bold, unique, and bursting with character. The Wick Liq Bar Juice collection sees the Staffordshire flavour experts apply a "double concentrate" formulation to their premium blends. By doubling the flavour dosage, these "Bar Salts" deliver an exceptionally intense and consistent taste experience that remains rich and full-bodied, even when used in low-power starter kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with refillable pod kits, producing discreet vapour and crystal-clear flavour. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liq Bar Juice Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
